# VISOR

> VISOR is an AI fitness app that predicts your before & after body transformation, delivers adaptive AI coaching, and uses gamified Soul Track streaks to keep you consistent.

## What VISOR does

- **AI Body Transformation**: Generates visual predictions of your future body at Month 1, Month 3, and Olympia mode from a starting photo and goals.
- **Visor AI Coach**: An emotionally intelligent coach that adapts tone and personality to your mood, motivation, and training context.
- **Soul Track**: A gamified identity-alignment system that rewards behaviors tied to the person you want to become, not just workouts completed.
- **Personalized Plans**: Adaptive workout and nutrition programs.
- **Personal Coaching** (Elite): Human coaches available on the top tier.

## Pricing

- **Free** — core tracking and limited AI features.
- **Core** ($9.99/mo) — full AI coaching and transformation previews.
- **Elite** ($19.99/mo) — everything in Core plus personal coaching access.

## Platform

- iOS and Android mobile app.
- Website: https://charmflow-vision.lovable.app/

- Premium "Liquid Glass" aesthetic, dark theme with orange accents.
- Positioning: identity-driven AI fitness, not just tracking.
